summary: Fixed-harness fixture LH mobile TBT 558-991 ms; 90-95% of it is vendor-react long tasks after FCP, i.e. hydration plus what runs right after it. At 4x CPU React is 60-80% busy from 1.5 to 7.5 s and only ~0.5 of ~3.0 s runs before the root commit. Hot single tasks: root pass 361 ms; --sticky-header-h written on :root (recalc of 874 elements, 137-177 ms, plus forced layout); refetch plus ticker animation (recalc 115-196 + layout 143-192 ms); mobile device-switch re-render (25 style swaps, 166-198 ms recalc). Production post-hydration network is 6 PostgREST + 6 preflights + 1 serverFn, not 15 PostgREST; each has a code-level cause. Dropping 61% of the DOM (sections 2-8, footer) cut React work only ~25%. So islands must be preceded by killing the storm and the device switch, which would otherwise force client renders. Combined plan: mobile TBT to ~150-300 ms on the fixture.

changes.title: Count dehydrated query freshness from hydration time, not SSR render time
changes.mechanism: In the router.options.hydrate wrapper (router.tsx:197-211), after the integration hydrates the initial batch and the setTimeout(0) tick, re-stamp every query whose state.status==='success' && dataUpdatedAt>0 to dataUpdatedAt=Date.now() (via queryCache.find + setState). Do the same for queries arriving through the render-phase queryStream (wrap guardQueryStream consumer or subscribe to cache 'added' events for 2 s). Seeds with updatedAt:0 keep 0 (explicitly stale). Rationale: the edge certified the whole document; client staleness should start when the reader sees it.
changes.expected_effect: -1..-3 PostgREST (+preflights) whenever document age > staleTime (prod sample 316 s > 300 s); removes 1 <style> swap + full recalc (115-177 ms at 4x) -> TBT mobile -65..-125 ms when it lands after FCP
changes.estimate_basis: prod HTML dataUpdatedAt vs prod beacon timestamp (316 s); runs/m4-ok-1 ULT after token refetch 115-196 ms at 4x; LH maps observed 1x tasks x4
changes.risk_notes: Data can be stale by at most edge doc age + staleTime (doc fresh window 3 min + SWR); invalidations by staff still work (realtime bridges for logged-in users). Must not re-stamp error/pending queries.
gates: test (new router hydration unit test: success queries re-stamped, updatedAt:0 seeds untouched)
changes.verification: trace.mjs --backend=ok on a document older than 5 min (or with Date.now mocked +6 min): zero site_design_tokens/site_global_colors refetch; LH network-requests shows no token fetch; mutation log shows no data-css-hash style swap.

changes.title: One site_design_tokens row query with derived selectors; warm post_layout_settings and font scale for real
changes.mechanism: Introduce siteDesignTokensRowQueryOptions (single key, same fetchSiteDesignTokensRow + edgeTtlCache). designTokens/globalColors/fontScale become `select` projections (or queryOptions whose queryFn reads the cached row). The root loader warms ONE row query instead of two, which frees cacheWrites (ceiling dehydrationWritesPerLoader 11, zero headroom, ssrBudgets.ts:139-152). Spend one freed write on ensureQueryData(postLayoutSettingsQueryOptions) in wave 1 (edgeTtlCache row, parallel arm count stays <= 6) and delete the updatedAt:0 seed at __root.tsx:694-699 when the warm succeeded (keep the seed only as failure fallback).

changes.title: Stop full-document restyle and forced layout from Header measurements
changes.mechanism: (a) Register `@property --sticky-header-h { syntax: '<length>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 96px }` and keep it only on <html> (html { scroll-padding-top } reads it on the same element). Make `[id] { scroll-margin-top }` not depend on the variable (scroll-padding on the root scroller already offsets anchors); a non-inherited property change restyles only <html>. (b) Replace the synchronous getBoundingClientRect() in the mount path of both effects (Header.tsx:431-531, 548-585) with the first ResizeObserver entry (borderBoxSize), so no forced layout runs inside the hydration commit. Skip the write when |height - current| < 2.

changes.title: No whole-tree device re-render after hydration on mobile
changes.mechanism: Option B (first, low risk): keep desktop-first SSR but defer the viewport-device transition until first user interaction or until all islands are hydrated, plus a long quiet window (>=10 s). CSS already lays out mobile correctly (comment BuilderRenderer.tsx:238-241). Precondition: audit device-dependent behaviour in widgets (visibility filter dy(), slider items per view) and move it to CSS where it differs. Option A (durable): SSR the device class from Sec-CH-UA-Mobile (sent by default by Chromium) / UA 'Mobi', render BuilderRenderer with device prop, include the device class in the edge document cache key (2 variants per URL), and initialise viewportDevice from the SSR data-device attribute so the client never switches for phones; ResizeObserver still corrects tablets.
changes.expected_effect: -0.4..-0.6 s React work at 4x on mobile, -25 <style> swaps, -1 recalc of ~800 elements (166-198 ms 4x) -> TBT mobile -150..-300 ms; removes the main source of forced island client-renders

changes.risk_notes: B: visible behaviour difference until switch (per-device hidden widgets must be CSS-hidden). A: cache key change (server-cache workstream), tablet misclassification -> one correction re-render, parity tests.

changes.title: Overlay gating: consent banner SSR shell + pre-paint toggle; popups, toaster and telemetry on interaction
changes.mechanism: ConsentBanner: SSR renders static banner markup (copy + Accept/Reject/Settings) inside [data-consent-shell], hidden by CSS. A pre-paint inline script (THEME_INIT_SCRIPT family) sets html[data-consent=pending] when no stored decision exists, so the shell paints at FCP without touching React-managed attributes. A delegated click handler in the same script records Accept/Reject (cookie + ga4ConsentUpdate) and marks consentReported. The React banner chunk loads on first interaction with the shell or anywhere. Replace the 6 lucide icons with inline SVG, and the 'enter' filter animation with opacity/transform. NewsletterPopup/PopupHost/Toaster: mount on first interaction OR at the popup's own configured delay (computed from dehydrated newsletter-settings without mounting), with a fallback of a 15 s quiet window instead of afterPageLoad(3000). The 'impression' event is sent with 'open' or via sendBeacon on first interaction/pagehide.
changes.metric: TBT, bytes in load window, LCP stability, network
changes.expected_effect: -160 KB raw JS evaluated in the window (ConsentBanner 44 + vendor-lucide 63 + sonner 35 + popup chunks ~22) and their renders; -1 PostgREST (builder_popups) -1 preflight -1 serverFn POST; TBT -50..-120 ms mobile; consent visible at FCP instead of ~4 s (no late LCP candidate)

changes.risk_notes: Legal contract (__root.tsx:224-257): the banner may only be delayed, never conditional. The shell makes it visible sooner, and the shell state must feed overlayCoordinator.consentReported so marketing overlays still wait. 'immediate' builder popups would wait for interaction (business decision). Shell markup must be identical for all visitors (edge-cached HTML).

changes.title: Deferred-hydration islands for below-the-fold sections and the footer
changes.mechanism: New client-only HydrationIsland: inside the (existing or added) <Suspense> of StreamingSection, render `use(islandGate(section.id))` on the client (SSR renders children directly, IS_SSR branch). A section that does not stream today gets the same Suspense boundary on both server and client. The gate promise resolves on the first of: IntersectionObserver(root [data-sec-id], rootMargin '0px 0px 100% 0px'); first interaction anywhere (pointerdown/keydown/touchstart/wheel/scroll), then remaining islands hydrate one per requestIdleCallback; own-root focusin/pointerdown (capture); no time-only trigger before 15 s. Apply to home/page sections index >= 1 and the footer BuilderRenderer; never in builder canvas/editorPreview. The fallback is SectionStreamSkeleton(minHeight=estimateSectionHeight) instead of null as a CLS safety net. Lazy widget chunks of island sections are requested only when the gate opens.

changes.expected_effect: -0.6..-0.9 s React work at 4x, style -45%, layout -70%, ~25 fewer chunk requests in the window (JoinUs group, TailoredMustReads + second pl dictionary, WidgetView + radix-select group) -> TBT mobile -150..-250 ms, PSI desktop -80..-150 ms

Requires H1/H2/H3/H6 plus an audit of ThemeProvider/i18n/AccessContext updates after mount (auth already uses startTransition, useAuth.tsx:259-268). Clicks on unhydrated buttons are not replayed (own-root pointerdown/focusin trigger mitigates; links navigate natively).

changes.title: Cheaper per-widget hydration in the generic renderer
changes.mechanism: (a) Call useGlobalWidgetNode only in a child rendered when instanceNode.globalId is set (ChromeWidgetView.tsx:168), so non-global widgets create no QueryObserver. (b) Per-widget typography/wrapper CSS: server-only generation with data-css-hash and client read-back from the SSR <style> (the C3 pattern already used by DesignTokensStyle); regenerate only on data change. (c) Memoise shouldStreamSection per section object (WeakMap) instead of recomputing sectionQueryOptionsList on every client render (sectionStreaming.tsx:212-216). (d) Cache cn() results for static argument tuples (Map keyed by joined string). (e) DynamicIcon: for non-curated names keep the SSR SVG markup (read from DOM) instead of loading icons-N JSON (103-115 KB). (f) CountryCombobox: compute the sorted Intl country list lazily on open.

changes.title: Make the root hydration pass yield (investigate the non-yielding 361 ms task)
changes.mechanism: Measure with a React profiling build in an experiment worktree (react-dom/profiling alias) which lane the root hydration renders in. If a SyncLane update (useSyncExternalStore change during hydration in router/consent/auth stores, or a layout-effect setState) entangles it, move those updates to passive effects or startTransition. Also move the anonymous Supabase client creation out of the hydration commit (AuthProvider effect, F0 19 ms).

css: H5 edits styles.css:6678-6683 and adds @property; H9 consent shell CSS; H6 option B needs device-neutral widget CSS.
html-weight: H9 adds ~3-5 KB SSR consent markup; H7 adds <!--$--> pairs for static sections; H2 changes dehydrated payload by +-1 entry.
lcp-path: H9 paints the consent shell at FCP; it may become the LCP element on mobile (likely positive). Fewer chunks in the window (H7/H8/H9) reduce bandwidth contention before LCP.
third-party: gtag is 153 of 200 ms TBT on the prod laptop run; this workstream's interaction trigger (shared first-interaction signal) should be the same module gtagLoadPolicy uses.

measurement: the dead 127.0.0.1:4199 browser backend inflates the storm (18+18 retried vs 6+6) and hides refetch re-renders; an in-process route (trace.mjs --backend=ok) or a shared fixture server for the browser is needed to measure H1-H3.
